Maya CSM: Quick ask — HelixHealth goes live in 6h. Finance flagged demo latency and renewal in 50 days. Can we give them a 1-page Day0 runbook for prefill, batching, streaming fallback, and a tiny metrics capture template? Need copy/paste steps.

Ruth CS-Ops: Yep. I'll make it very short and customer-facing. Also add a 3-step internal checklist for CS.

Omar SRE: Baseline Qs: which model and is streaming on? That affects thresholds.

Maya CSM: They're on 7B-q4, streaming enabled on chat route. Observed p95 ~480ms p99 ~1.7s during demo.

Vik Eng: Draft Day0 runbook (customer copy/paste):

```
1) Turn on Warm Pools: Settings > Performance > Warm Pools -> ON.
2) Prefill top intents: prefill.intents = [greet,search,summary,billing]; cadence = 30m.
3) Warm slots: start = 2 (increase +1 per 500 DAU).
4) Client batching: client_window_ms = 25 (jitter +/-10ms); max_batch = 48. Alt: if UX spiky, use 10ms window and max_batch = 24.
5) Prefix cache: session_ttl = 10m; templates_ttl = 1h.
6) Streaming guardrail: stream_threshold_ms = 750 -> on exceed, switch to fallback_model = "7B-lite-q4".
7) Telemetry: export p50,p95,p99,tokens to CSV at T-24h and T+48h.
```

Ruth CS-Ops: Internal CS checklist: 1) confirm warm_pool active; 2) run 8 synthetic prefills across intents; 3) verify p95 < 400ms or flag escalation.

Omar SRE: Ops snippets if they permit Redwood assist: `rbnctl warmup --tenant helix --slots 3 --intents top_intents.json --at 03:00` and health check `rbnctl health --tenant helix --route /generate --samples 5`. Also schedule warm-pool auto-scale-down after 72h idle.

Claire PM: For renewal tracking: ask customer to upload CSV daily for 3 days (columns: timestamp,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens,requests,error_rate). If p99 improves by >=30% mark as risk reduced.

Maya CSM: Great. Ruth can you convert this to one-page PDF and include a short consent checkbox text for warm-pool assist we can use in the kickoff?

Ruth CS-Ops: Yes — will attach PDF and the consent snippet: "I authorize Redwood to run a 72-hour warm-pool assist for my tenant."

oncall-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant helix at 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z (3 slots) created by Ruth CS-Ops

Vik Eng: One more note for customers: if you see noisy latency after warmup, prefer smaller batch window (10ms) to keep tail latency predictable.

Maya CSM: Perfect . I'll share PDF in the kickoff and request the consent. We'll collect T+48h CSV and update the renewal board. Thanks team.
